name: Hansen

origin.summary: Honors Marine Staff Sergeant Daniel Hansen, killed in Farah Province, Afghanistan, on February 14, 2009, by an improvised explosive device. Five rounds of heavy swings, burpees, and GHD sit-ups — a midline crucible.

description: Five rounds of 30 kettlebell swings, 30 burpees, and 30 GHD sit-ups — a straightforward high-rep triplet.
source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08
